arxiv-2212-11038.title: Generalised quadratic forms over totally real number fields
arxiv-2212-11038.creator: Tim Browning, Lillian B. Pierce, Damaris Schindler
arxiv-2212-11038.description: Abstract . We introduce a new class of generalised quadratic forms over totally real number fields, which is rich enough to capture the arithmetic of arbitrary systems of quadrics over the rational numbers. We explore this connection through a version of the Hardy–Littlewood circle method over number fields. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 11P55 (11D09, 14G05) 1.

arxiv-2305-16922.title: Fast refacing of MR images with a generative neural network lowers re-identification risk and preserves volumetric consistency
arxiv-2305-16922.creator: Nataliia Molchanova, Bénédicte Maréchal, Jean-Philippe Thiran, Tobias Kober, Till Huelnhagen, Jonas Richiardi, for the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
arxiv-2305-16922.description: Abstract With the rise of open data, identifiability of individuals based on 3D renderings obtained from routine structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans of the head has become a growing privacy concern. To protect subject privacy, several algorithms have been developed to de-identify imaging data using blurring, defacing or refacing.

arxiv-2310-05195.title: GMMFormer: Gaussian-Mixture-Model Based Transformer for Efficient Partially Relevant Video Retrieval
arxiv-2310-05195.creator: Yuting Wang, Jinpeng Wang, Bin Chen, Ziyun Zeng, Shu-Tao Xia
arxiv-2310-05195.description: Abstract Given a text query, partially relevant video retrieval (PRVR) seeks to find untrimmed videos containing pertinent moments in a database. For PRVR, clip modeling is essential to capture the partial relationship between texts and videos. Current PRVR methods adopt scanning-based clip construction to achieve explicit clip modeling, which is information-redundant and requires a large storage overhead.

arxiv-2407-13384.title: Movement-based models for abundance data
arxiv-2407-13384.creator: Ricardo Carrizo Vergara, Marc Kéry, Trevor Hefley
arxiv-2407-13384.description: Abstract Abstract We develop two statistical models for space-time abundance data based on a stochastic underlying continuous individual movement. In contrast to current models for abundance in statistical ecology, our models exploit the explicit connection between movement and counts, including the induced space-time auto-correlation.

arxiv-2503-03601.title: Feature-Level Insights into Artificial Text Detection with Sparse Autoencoders
arxiv-2503-03601.creator: Kristian Kuznetsov, Laida Kushnareva, Polina Druzhinina, Anton Razzhigaev, Anastasia Voznyuk, Irina Piontkovskaya, Evgeny Burnaev, Serguei Barannikov
arxiv-2503-03601.description: Abstract Artificial Text Detection (ATD) is becoming increasingly important with the rise of advanced Large Language Models (LLMs). Despite numerous efforts, no single algorithm performs consistently well across different types of unseen text or guarantees effective generalization to new LLMs. Interpretability plays a crucial role in achieving this goal.

arxiv-2510-06307.title: Belief-Calibrated Multi-Agent Consensus Seeking for Complex NLP Tasks
arxiv-2510-06307.creator: Wentao DengShandong University wentao.deng@mail.sdu.edu.cn Jiahuan PeiVU Amsterdam j.pei2@vu.nl Zhiwei XuShandong University zhiwei_xu@sdu.edu.cn Zhaochun RenLeiden University z.ren@liacs.leidenuniv.nl Zhumin ChenShandong University chenzhumin@sdu.edu.cn, Pengjie RenShandong University renpengjie@sd
arxiv-2510-06307.description: Abstract A MAS ( MAS ) enhances its capacity to solve complex NLP ( NLP ) tasks through collaboration among multiple agents, where consensus-seeking serves as a fundamental mechanism. However, existing consensus-seeking approaches typically rely on voting mechanisms to judge consensus, overlooking contradictions in system-internal beliefs that destabilize the consensus.

arxiv-2511-04946.title: The Future of Fully Homomorphic Encryption System: from a Storage I/O Perspective
arxiv-2511-04946.creator: Lei Chen, Erci Xu, Yiming Sun, Shengyu Fan, Xianglong Deng, Guiming Shi, Guang Fan, Liang Kong, Yilan Zhu, Shoumeng Yan, Mingzhe Zhang ∗
arxiv-2511-04946.description: Abstract Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) allows computations to be performed on encrypted data, significantly enhancing user privacy. However, the I/O challenges associated with deploying FHE applications remains understudied. We analyze the impact of storage I/O on the performance of FHE applications and summarize key lessons from the status quo.

arxiv-2512-19781.title: Theory of Scalable Spin Squeezing with Disordered Quantum Dipoles
arxiv-2512-19781.creator: Avi Kaplan-Lipkin, Philip J. D. Crowley, Jonathan N. Hallén, Zilin Wang, Weijie Wu, Sabrina Chern, Chris R. Laumann, Lode Pollet, Norman Y. Yao
arxiv-2512-19781.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Avi Kaplan-Lipkin, Philip J. D. Crowley, Jonathan N. Hallén, Zilin Wang, Weijie Wu, Sabrina Chern, Chris R. Laumann, Lode Pollet, Norman Y. Yao. Spin squeezed entanglement enables metrological precision beyond the classical limit. Understood through the lens of continuous symmetry breaking, dipolar spin systems exhibit the remarkable ability to generate spin squeezing via their intrinsic quench dynamics.

arxiv-2512-24312.title: Gravitationally Induced Entanglement Between Particles in Harmonic Traps: Limits for Gaussian States
arxiv-2512-24312.creator: Julia Tokarska, Andrzej Dragan
arxiv-2512-24312.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Julia Tokarska, Andrzej Dragan. Gravitationally induced entanglement has been proposed as a probe of the quantum nature of gravity. This work analyzes a system of two particles in harmonic traps interacting only through gravity, considering thermal and two-mode squeezed initial states. For thermal states, a maximum temperature is identified above which entanglement cannot be generated, and for fixed system parameters an optimal trap frequency that maximizes the logarithmic negativity is found.

pmc-10523093.title: Undiagnosed dyspnea with pulmonary nodule
pmc-10523093.creator: Cheng‐Hsien Tsou, Hwa‐Yen Chiu
pmc-10523093.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Key messagePhysicians should remain vigilant about alternative causes of shortness of breath even when respiratory diseases are being effectively treated. The lateral view of chest radiography can be valuable in discerning the three‐dimensional characteristics of pulmonary abnormalities.Keywords: arteriovenous malformation, dyspnea, solitary pulmonary nodule CLINICAL IMAGE A 55‐year‐old female with childhood asthma came to our chest clinic for shortness of breath for months. She already received inhaled corticosteroids and bronchodilators but her symptoms persisted.

pmc-10650285.title: Human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor-2 Gastric Adenocarcinoma: Expanding Therapy of a Recognized Target
pmc-10650285.creator: Jane E Rogers, Kohei Yamashita, Matheus Sewastjanow-Silva, Allison Trail, Rebecca E Waters, Jaffer Ajani, Ernest Ramsay Camp
pmc-10650285.description: Simple SummaryHuman epidermal growth factor receptor-2 (HER2) is a well-known target for approximately 15% of gastric adenocarcinomas (GACs). Although a plethora of HER2-targeted agents are marketed, currently only two agents are approved for GAC. These two agents are used only in the metastatic setting.

pmc-11394908.title: Selenium-Binding Protein 1 (SBP1): A New Putative Player of Stress Sensing in Plants
pmc-11394908.creator: Irene Dervisi, Aikaterini Koletti, Adamantia Agalou, Kosmas Haralampidis, Emmanouil Flemetakis, Andreas Roussis
pmc-11394908.description: Selenium-binding proteins (SBPs) represent a ubiquitous and conserved protein family with yet unclear biochemical and molecular functions. The importance of the human homolog has been extensively studied as it is implicated in many cancer types and other diseases. On the other hand, little is known regarding plant homologs.

pmc-11457346.title: Characterizing visual field loss from past mercury exposure in an Indigenous riverine community (Grassy Narrows First Nation, Canada): a cluster-based approach
pmc-11457346.creator: Aline Philibert, Benoit Tousignant, Myriam Fillion, Judy Da Silva, Donna Mergler
pmc-11457346.description: BackgroundBetween 1962 and 1975, a chlor-alkali plant in Canada discharged approximately 9 metric tons of mercury (Hg) into the Wabigoon River. Over the following decades, biomarkers of Hg exposure of persons from Grassy Narrows First Nation (Asubpeeschoseewagong Anishinabek), located downriver from the discharge, reflected Hg concentrations in fish.

pmc-11461493.title: Intermetallics triggering pyroptosis and disulfidptosis in cancer cells promote anti-tumor immunity
pmc-11461493.creator: Yanlin Zhu, Xinxin Wang, Lili Feng, Ruoxi Zhao, Can Yu, Yuanli Liu, Ying Xie, Bin Liu, Yang Zhou, Piaoping Yang
pmc-11461493.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Pyroptosis, an immunogenic programmed cell death, could efficiently activate tumor immunogenicity and reprogram immunosuppressive microenvironment for boosting cancer immunotherapy. However, the overexpression of SLC7A11 promotes glutathione biosynthesis for maintaining redox balance and countering pyroptosis.

pmc-11634989.title: Recurrent Heatwaves Slow Down the Recovery of a Phytoplankton Community
pmc-11634989.creator: Francesco Polazzo, Markus Hermann, Melina Crettaz‐Minaglia, Andreu Rico
pmc-11634989.description: Heatwaves (HWs) are predicted to increase in frequency and severity due to climate change. Yet, there is limited information about how ecological resilience of aquatic communities is going to be impacted by recurrent HWs. Here, we used data from an outdoor freshwater mesocosm experiment where a semi‐natural phytoplankton community was exposed to three subsequent HWs.

pmc-11690895.title: BARRIERS AND BENEFITS TO TECHNOLOGY ADOPTION BY DEMENTIA CAREGIVERS
pmc-11690895.creator: Patti Simone, Julia Scott, Sheila Yueter, Emma Cepukenas, McKenzie Himes, Kennedy Anderson, An Mai, Kiren Grewal
pmc-11690895.description: Technology can support caregivers of people with dementia but to date, they are not adopted at scale. We surveyed a range of caregivers regarding their use of technology they use to assist in caregiving tasks to better understand the relationship between technological tool use and satisfaction with caregiving.

pmc-11700729.title: Bronchoscopy Without Sedation in Healthy Volunteers
pmc-11700729.creator: Dean Kellogg, Diego Maselli, Kevin Proud, Eusondia Arnett, Larry S Schlesinger, Jay I Peters
pmc-11700729.description: ration of IV moderate sedation to comfort, but this carries a range of potential adverse events, including respiratory depression, hypotension, and vomiting. In contrast, topical anesthesia offers a shorter duration of action and a wider therapeutic index.3 Although upper airway endoscopy is performed commonly without sedation, the tolerability of sampling the lower airways without sedation has not been studied systematically.

pmc-12618892.title: The evolving landscape of antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) for treatment of prostate cancer
pmc-12618892.creator: Claire Lin, Matthew J. Hadfield, Ariana Santopietro, Galina Lagos, Liang Cheng, Wafik S. El-Deiry, Rahul Aggarwal, Anthony Mega, Elias Hyams, Benedito A. Carneiro
pmc-12618892.description: Advances in antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) technology and identification of new antigen targets are repositioning ADCs as a promising therapeutic platform for metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC). This review summarizes recent progress in ADC payload and linker chemistry, highlights membrane antigens in prostate cancer that have demonstrated encouraging antitumor activity in clinical trials, and addresses strategies to mitigate off-target toxicity.

pmc-12641649.title: Histopathologic Features and Molecular Markers of Encephalocraniocutaneous Lipomatosis (ECCL)
pmc-12641649.creator: Siddharth Venigalla, Tanvir K Dhaliwal, Anvita Anumolu, Lena Rafey, Arturo P Saavedra, David D Limbrick, G Kaya
pmc-12641649.description: Encephalocraniocutaneous lipomatosis (ECCL) is a rare congenital neurocutaneous disorder characterized by ocular, skin, and central nervous system manifestations. Despite its recognizable clinical features, such as nevus psiloliparus, histopathologic characterization of ECCL remains limited in the dermatopathology literature, and diagnosis is often clinical.

pmc-12705655.title: Organ-specific delivery of an mRNA-encoded bispecific T cell engager targeting glypican-3 in hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-12705655.creator: Yan Huang, Shaoli Liu, Xiaoju Zhang, Bingxu Zhang, Feng Shi, Jia Zhang, Shuaibo Shao, Hongya Han, Xiaoyun Ma, Jing Xie, Jianqi Zhang, Hongxiaoying Yu, Yongchao Zhao, Jiazheng Jin, Dong Xu, Liang Liu, Jianing Wang, Yu Tan, Kelu Xu, Lushuai Jin, Quanjun Du, Yifeng Geng, Andong Liu, Wei Xu
pmc-12705655.description: T-cell engager (TCE)-based immunotherapy is clinically validated in hematological cancers. However, application in solid tumors faces hurdles including T cell penetration, the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment, and toxicity. We develop an mRNA-encoded TCE (MTS105) targeting Glypican-3, the hepatocellular carcinoma antigen, delivered via lipid nanoparticles directly to liver tissue. In mice, rats, and cynomolgus monkeys, MTS105 exhibits higher liver exposure versus plasma.

pmc-12784667.title: Generation of Novel High-Quality Small-Grained Rice Germplasm by Targeting the OsVIN2 Gene
pmc-12784667.creator: Xi Chen, Yarong Lin, Xiangzhe Xi, Shaohua Yang, Shiyu Wu, Hongge Qian, Mingji Wu, Taijiao Hu, Fating Mei, Mengyan Zheng, Chuanlin Shi, Yiwang Zhu
pmc-12784667.description: Simple SummarySmall-grained rice is valuable for hybrid seed production and food markets, but developing high-quality small-grained varieties is challenging. This study aimed to use the CRISPR/Cas9 gene-editing technique to modify the OsVIN2 gene in rice variety MH86, hoping to reduce grain size while improving quality. We successfully edited OsVIN2, resulting in rice grains that were shorter and narrower than normal.

pmc-13122369.title: The Effect of Mental Health Education on the Resilience and Psychosocial Adjustment in Patients with Heart Failure under the Care of Home Counseling and Nursing Services: A Randomized Controlled Trial

pmc-13122369.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: Heart failure is a clinical syndrome that has a large financial burden on the health care system and communities. One of the types of care provided to these patients is home care.

pmc-13125737.title: Transcript‐Specific DNA Methylation Alterations of the RASSF1 Locus in Cancer Cells
pmc-13125737.creator: Litzy Gisella Bermudez, Camila Bernal Forigua, Carmen María Ayala‐Roldán, Jesús Manuel Romero, Rafael R. Ariza, Teresa Morales‐Ruiz, Teresa Roldán‐Arjona, Alejandra Cañas, Adriana Rojas
pmc-13125737.description: BackgroundThe locus encoding Ras association domain family member 1 (RASSF1) encodes multiple transcripts with opposing roles in cancer, such as RASSF1A (tumor suppressor), RASSF1C (oncogene), and the lncRNA RASSF1‐AS1 (function undefined). Although DNA methylation–mediated repression of RASSF1A expression has been extensively studied in different cancer types, the epigenetic regulation of RASSF1C and RASSF1‐AS1 is unclear.

pmc-13299591.title: Mapping Social and Physical Frailty in the Peruvian Amazon: Associated Factors Among Older Adults
pmc-13299591.creator: Fernando M. Runzer-Colmenares, Walter Mendoza, Nelson Luis Cahuapaza-Gutierrez, Kiara Camacho-Caballero, Jose F. Parodi
pmc-13299591.description: Background/Objectives: To analyze the determinants of frailty among older adults residing in the Peruvian Amazon, focusing on four complementary frailty-related outcomes. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted using secondary data from the Amazon frail study. Four multivariable Poisson regression models were specified.

pmc-13557354.title: HIV-1 lentivirus with VSV-G envelope: Complex N glycosylation governs shifts in aggregation and infectivity state at close to physiological pH, serum, and Ca2+ levels
pmc-13557354.creator: Tzu-Lan Chang, Ayobami I. Ogundiran, Andrey Ivanov, Gabrielle Torain, Sergei Nekhai, Preethi L. Chandran
pmc-13557354.description: The goal of the study is to determine if the N-glycosylation on a virus affects its diffusion or solution state in different environmental conditions, and if the nature of the solution states has any consequence for the virus infectivity. HIV-1 lentivirus is frequently pseudo-typed with the envelope protein of Vesicular Stomatitis Virus, VSV-G, for gene and cell therapy applications.

pmc-13670442.title: Efficacy of probiotics on immunological and clinical outcomes in allergic rhinitis: an umbrella review and updated meta-analysis of RCTs in children and adults
pmc-13670442.creator: Zhe Wang, Yao Lu
pmc-13670442.description: BackgroundAllergic rhinitis (AR) is a prevalent inflammatory condition with limited long-term treatment options. Probiotics have been investigated as immunomodulatory agents, yet evidence remains inconsistent. This umbrella review with updated meta-analysis evaluated probiotic efficacy on immunological and clinical outcomes in children and adults with AR.MethodsWe systematically searched PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, and Embase through May 2026.

pmc-13681806.title: FUBP1 lactylation suppresses trophoblast function in fetal growth restriction
pmc-13681806.creator: Xinyue Liang, Shenshen Yao, Jian Ma, Dan Wang
pmc-13681806.description: BackgroundFetal growth restriction (FGR) is a common complication of pregnancy; however, its exact molecular mechanisms remain unclear. Excessive lactate accumulation in the placenta is often observed during FGR. High concentrations of lactate can regulate the proliferation of pathological cells through lactylation of key proteins.
